title: Fuzzy e-Means: Fuzzy c-Means on Large Data with Moving-Average Mini-Batch Updates
abstract: arXiv:2611.29241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fuzzy c-means (FCM) gives every point a degree of membership in every cluster. Its standard solver, alternating optimization (AO), needs a full pass over the data per iteration and often many iterations, while methods built for large data stop at a worse objective or still need tens of passes. We run FCM with the optimizer of e-means, a recent mini-batch k-means that keeps moving averages of the number and the sum of the points in each cluster and sets its batch size and step size by scaling laws. The optimizer carries over because an FCM centroid is also a weighted sum divided by a total weight, but this direct transfer fails in two ways: the e-means rule that relocates nearly empty clusters also removes the centroids of small, distant groups, and FCM started from random points can settle in poor local minima. Fuzzy e-means (e-FCM) therefore starts with one pass of e-means with hard assignments and then runs fuzzy moving-average passes

translated_title: 模糊e均值：基于移动平均小批量更新的大数据模糊c均值
translated_abstract: 模糊c均值（FCM）为每个数据点赋予其在每个聚类中的隶属度。其标准求解器——交替优化（AO）——每次迭代需要对数据进行完整遍历，且往往需要多次迭代；而专为大数据设计的方法要么收敛到较差的目标函数值，要么仍需数十次数据遍历。我们采用e均值的优化器来运行FCM。e均值是近期提出的一种小批量k均值方法，它对每个聚类中的点数和点的坐标总和保持移动平均，并通过缩放定律设定批量大小和步长。该优化器之所以能够迁移，是因为FCM的质心同样是一个加权总和除以总权重。但这种直接迁移会在两个方面失效：e均值中重新安置近乎空聚类的规则会将小而远的群体的质心也移除；此外，从随机点出发的FCM可能陷入较差的局部极小值。因此，模糊e均值（e-FCM）先执行一遍基于硬分配的e均值，随后运行模糊的移动平均遍历。
tldr: 本文提出模糊e均值（e-FCM），将e均值的移动平均小批量优化器迁移到模糊c均值上，并通过先硬分配初始化、再模糊更新的两阶段策略解决了空簇误删和局部极小值问题，实现了大数据上的高效模糊聚类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes fuzzy e-means (e-FCM), which transfers the moving-average mini-batch optimizer of e-means to fuzzy c-means and adopts a two-stage strategy—hard-assignment initialization followed by fuzzy moving-average passes—to overcome cluster removal and poor local minima issues, enabling efficient fuzzy clustering on large datasets.
